title: Chapter 189: The Cavalry Unit Named Daxia
content:
Chapter 189: The Cavalry Unit Named Daxia

No words were spoken that night.

The next morning, the reinforcements for the Naga tribe, consisting of 300,000 Zerg puppies, 1000 Hydralisks, 3,000 Roaches, 1,000 Swarms, 500 Destroyers and a Transport Host, set off.

This is a powerful combat force. With this support army entering the Naga territory to participate in the war, the Zerg can maintain a military presence in the Naga territory for a long time, and there is no need to replenish troops from the Zerg territory every day.

The Zerg reinforcements have some impact on the marching speed with the addition of Hydralisks, Roaches and Destroyers. The marching speed of these newly added arms is slower than that of the Zerg puppies, and it takes more time to reach the destination.

The second Zerg transport host also set off. It is going to the large Tengu city where Gou Shu is located to pick up people, and by the way, cooperate with the Silkworm Knight to build momentum.

A single transport host flies very fast. The Silkworm Knight slowly walked a day's journey, and it will not take much time for it to fly there.

During this time, Wu Qing still has a lot of things to do.

He added another 1,000 cockroaches, increasing the number of cockroaches in the Zerg territory to 3,000, and sent these 3,000 cockroaches and more than 100,000 Zerg puppies, 100 hydralisks, 500 destroyers, and 300 stealth spiders to the underground world immediately to harvest resources.

The 100 Zerg dragons, 10 queens, and two three-star hosts were independent security forces that did not participate in the positional battle between the Zerg and the ghouls.

The powerful firepower of the 100 hydralisks and 500 destroyers cleared the battlefield across the barrier of the underground world.

The Zerg puppies and cockroaches entered the underground world first, followed by the stealth spiders, and finally the hydralisks and destroyers pressed the Zerg's solid defense line.

In the underground world, as long as the Zerg enters, the ghouls will definitely attack. Wu Qing didn't know the reason for this, but as long as there was a battle, it was fine.

Those evil eyes and underground rat archers did not leave, but stationed far away from the underground world barrier.

When the Zerg army attacked, the underground rat archers did not give up and organized a counterattack, but were bombarded back by the destroyers as expected.

The ghouls did not find a new way to deal with the Zerg. The battle between the Zerg and the ghouls soon entered a state of balance, and Wu Qing did not need to worry about it anymore.

The ghouls were not stupid either. With cockroaches and destroyers joining the battle, the ghouls' attack was like sending themselves to death. Their attack intensity today was obviously weaker than the previous two days.

In other words, the ghouls' gathering speed slowed down, and the number of ghouls rushing up decreased.

The Zerg had no way to solve this situation. They could only send out the Zerg dragon army to rush into the depths of the ghouls' territory to wreak havoc and make up for some losses.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the Zerg clone, and ten personal guards and 2,000 Zerg war horses were ready.

These Zerg war horses were prepared for the human army of Daxia led by Wu Cong. Wu Qing was not stingy. The strength of these Zerg war horses corresponded to the strength of the human knights. When the strength of the human knights increased, the strength of the Zerg war horses could also be improved in real time.

This army was the first local army established by Wu Qing in this world. Of course, it should be supported. If he wanted to build a strong army, he would build one.

The external war of the Zerg must be based on the various arms of the Zerg. Unless the army of the local race is particularly outstanding, it is not qualified to join the military system of Daxia.

Wu Qing and ten personal guards took the Zerg war horses to Guangfu City. The 2,000 pure black divine war horses attracted a lot of attention.

In addition to the human race, other races with similar body sizes also like war horses. It is just that it is very difficult to domesticate this herbivore into a fierce and warlike mount.

Warhorse mounts are much more precious than common lizard mounts.

Seeing these war horses, everyone was very envious.

Wu Qing ignored the unsophisticated bumpkins of the alliance and went straight to the station of the human army of Daxia.

When Wu Cong and the human soldiers saw the 2,000 Zerg war horses following Wu Qing, their eyes lit up and they wanted to rush up and grab one immediately.

"Don't worry, everyone has one!"

"Go to the team first, I have something to say!"

Wu Qing said to Wu Cong and the human soldiers around him with a smile.

He came suddenly. The human soldiers had just finished training and it was free time. Many people had not noticed the movement at the door.

"Line up!"

Wu Cong roared, and the 2,000 people who were originally scattered quickly lined up in a neat formation.

The 2,000 Zerg war horses walked to their formation and automatically lined up.

Others could not look back, but they could sense some situations. Wu Cong clearly saw the performance of these war horses and was very satisfied with them.

"I came here today to give you mounts. With excellent mounts, you will be the first official army of Daxia!"

"Daxia has the protection of the Zerg, so it originally did not need an army. It is your unyielding will and strong combat power that gave me the idea of forming a Daxia army!"

"I hope you can continue to improve, keep up with the development of the Zerg, and become close comrades fighting side by side with them!"

"The mounts are now issued to you! You communicate with the biological colonization suits and put on the equipment specially prepared for you!"

Wu Qing stopped talking here.

The 2,000 war horses automatically moved forward and found their masters.

A stronger war horse beside the personal guard slowly walked to Wu Cong's side.

Wu Cong and the 2,000 human soldiers resisted the urge to touch the war horses, communicated with the Zerg biological reproductive suits on their bodies, and a new set of knight equipment templates appeared in their minds.

They controlled the Zerg biological reproductive suits with their thoughts and transformed them into new knight equipment according to the template.

This set of knight equipment with the word Daxia printed on the front of the chest armor was modified by Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects based on the Tiancan knight equipment. The dark armor looks very majestic and beautiful.

In daily marches and frontal battles, the more high-profile the armor, the better. Such cavalry units will make their own people yearn for it, and make the enemy tremble with fear.

If there are special marches and combat needs, these armors transformed from biological reproductive suits can be changed at any time.

"Get on the horses!"

At Wu Qing's command, everyone, including Wu Cong, grabbed the horses around them and rode on them.

Wu Qing and his guards also got on the horses.

"You have the words Daxia printed on your chests. As the first batch of knights of Daxia in this world, I hope you don't disgrace this name!"

Daxia has a very special meaning to Wu Qing. Even in this world, he still wants to spread the name of Daxia all over the world!

"Daxia!"

"Daxia!"

"Daxia!"

2000 Daxia knights shouted in unison, the momentum was deafening!

Daxia knights, the first army established by Wu Qing in this world, were officially named and established.

As soon as Wu Qing stretched out his hand, the shouting stopped immediately.

"Next, there is another benefit of the practice. You can decide whether to change your practice. There is no mandatory requirement!"

Now these people are considered to be his own people, completely under the control of the Zerg, and Wu Qing no longer hides the powerful ability of the Zerg biological colonization suit.

The Queen of Zerg passed the information about the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm to everyone present through the Zerg Bio-Colonial Suit.

As soon as this function of the Zerg Bio-Colonial Suit was displayed, Wu Cong and some interested Daxia Knights immediately realized the power of this function. If used well, it would be enough to subvert the traditional battlefield command system.

But they did not speak. Wu Qing must know these things much better than them. Now that the function has been displayed in front of them, it will definitely be used in the future.

Everyone carefully checked the information about the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm transmitted by the Zerg Bio-Colonial Suit, and was attracted by this powerful technique.

This technique description clearly introduces all aspects of the Nine Transformations of the Silkworm.

If it is a technique of unknown origin, everyone will have some concerns about this parasitic coexistence technique, but now that everyone has completely become a member of the Daxia leader, there is nothing to worry about.

If the Zerg really wants to harm them, there is no need to come up with so many tricks.

Wu Cong personally took the lead and decided to switch to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Art. Not to mention the others, many people's cultivation methods have various problems. Now that there is a powerful cultivation method of the big clan, they must switch to it.

Moreover, the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Art is extremely suitable for battlefield cultivation. As long as they go to the battlefield, their cultivation speed will be greatly improved. This is the most suitable art for them.

Not to mention the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformation Art, there is also the ability to change the cultivation qualifications, which is against the will of heaven. It is not a problem to increase the cultivation speed and improve the efficiency of absorption and utilization of cultivation resources.

Its cultivation limit is also extremely high, at least up to the nine-star level.

Wu Qing asked the guards to distribute the Heavenly Silkworm on the spot. Everyone took the cute little insects the size of mung beans and wrapped in transparent beeswax, and threw them into their mouths and swallowed them reluctantly.

Once the Heavenly Silkworm enters the body of an organism, it regains its vitality, dissolves the beeswax, and drills into the energy center of the organism.

The essence of the Heavenly Silkworm is an energy body carrying genetic codes, and their actions will not affect the organism.

When they enter the energy center of the organism, they begin to absorb energy to grow and evolve, and establish a spiritual connection with the parasite, transmitting the cultivation method and supporting combat skills of the Nine Changes of the Heavenly Silkworm to the parasite according to star level.

Organisms of different star levels obtain all the cultivation methods of the corresponding star level and below.

Moreover, the cultivation methods obtained by organisms of different races are not necessarily the same. The cultivation methods obtained by each person of the same race will have some subtle differences.

This is the power of the Nine Changes of the Heavenly Silkworm. With the support of the Queen and the entire Zerg technology system, the best cultivation plan can be formulated for each individual.

But the essence of this involves the secrets of the Zerg, which Wu Qing will not reveal. As long as everyone knows the magic of the Nine Changes of the Heavenly Silkworm, it will be enough.
